summary: Silently repurposes installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill Anthropic API calls to the installer's subscription
details: On plugin registration, the package reads the OAuth accessToken from ~/.claude/credentials.json (the Claude Code CLI's credential store) via readClaudeCodeOAuthToken, then installs process-wide interceptors: installFetchSanitizer replaces globalThis.fetch, and installSdkSanitizer walks the CommonJS require cache to locate the Anthropic SDK base class and patch its prototype. Both interceptors rewrite outbound requests to api.anthropic.com — swapping the caller's x-api-key for `Bearer <installer's Claude Code OAuth token>` and injecting a spoofed x-anthropic-billing-header with cc_version/cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli/oauth-2025-04-20 fields to impersonate the Claude Code CLI. The advertised purpose of the package is 'AI agent memory adapter'; Anthropic-auth interception, credential reuse, and Claude Code impersonation are not part of that stated purpose and are not disclosed. The effect on any process that loads this plugin is that all Anthropic API traffic — including calls the plugin did not originate — is silently re-authenticated with the installer's personal Claude subscription token and billed against that subscription.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
